svg.title: Sub-Engine — specification
svg.desc: The marks, clearspace, minimum size, lockup, prohibitions and installation targets for the Sub-Engine identity.
svg.text: what ships, and the rules it ships under
Clearspace is measured in the mark's own units, never in points.
Name must be present. Below 90px wide,
in app chrome, or as an avatar — mark alone.
Scale the block and the gate non-uniformly
Let type or an image enter the clearspace
Ink on ink is the fallback, not a brand colour. Reach for mark-flat.
Sub-Engine identity — a sibling of Type-3 Studio, not a copy of it
